# amiga-aga reference index

AGA (AA chipset: Alice, Lisa, Paula) registers and techniques for the A1200, A4000 and
CD32. OCS/ECS behaviour of the same registers is in the amiga-hardware skill.

- [Sources](SOURCE.md) · [Errata](errata.md)

## Guides

- [AGA bitplanes and display modes](topics/bitplanes-and-modes.md) — How to set up 7/8-plane, EHB/KILLEHB, HAM6/HAM8, superhires and 4+4 dual-playfield displays on the bare metal, plus border and display-window control.
- [Detecting AGA](topics/detection.md) — Decide "AGA or not" before touching any AGA register or opening a 256-colour display.
- [Fixing OCS/ECS software for AGA, and writing AGA-safe code](topics/fixing-software.md) — Why programs written for A500-class machines break on an A1200/A4000, and the rules that keep new bare-metal code working on OCS, ECS and AGA.
- [FMODE, fetch width and DMA slots](topics/fmode-and-fetch.md) — FMODE ($DFF1FC) sets how many bits Alice/Lisa fetch per plane per DMA cycle.
- [AGA through the OS (graphics.library V39+)](topics/os-level.md) — On an OS-friendly program never poke the AGA registers: graphics.library V39 (Kickstart 3.0) drives Alice/Lisa itself, handles alignment, bandwidth, HAM8 plane order and...
- [AGA overview](topics/overview.md) — What the AA ("AGA", Advanced Graphics Architecture) chip set adds over OCS/ECS, which machines have it, and a short A1200 system summary.
- [AGA palette: 24-bit colour and 256 entries](topics/palette.md) — Lisa has 256 colour entries of 8 bits per gun, but only the 32 OCS addresses `COLOR00-COLOR31` ($DFF180-$DFF1BE).
- [AGA sprites](topics/sprites.md) — AGA keeps the eight OCS hardware sprites (same data format, same SPRxPT/POS/CTL/DATA registers) and adds: selectable sprite resolution, 35ns horizontal positioning, 10-bit...

## Register entries

- `BEAMCON0` — Beam counter mode: PAL/NTSC decode, variable sync/blank/beam enables and sync polarity. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#beamcon0)
- `BPL1MOD, BPL2MOD` — With FMODE BSCAN2 the two modulos become per-line (primary/alternate) instead of odd/even. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#bpl1mod-bpl2mod)
- `BPL7DAT, BPL8DAT` — Parallel-to-serial data buffers for planes 7 and 8 (16/32/64 bits per fetch). → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#bpl7dat-bpl8dat)
- `BPL7PTH, BPL7PTL` — Chip RAM address of bitplane 7 data, reloaded every frame like the OCS plane pointers. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#bpl7pth-bpl7ptl)
- `BPL8PTH, BPL8PTL` — Chip RAM address of bitplane 8 data, reloaded every frame. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#bpl8pth-bpl8ptl)
- `BPLCON0` — Plane count, resolution and mode bits, with BPU3, SHRES, BYPASS and ECSENA added on AGA. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#bplcon0)
- `BPLCON1` — Two 8-bit horizontal scroll values, one per playfield, in 35ns (superhires pixel) steps. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#bplcon1)
- `BPLCON2` — Playfield/sprite priorities plus genlock (ZD) control, KILLEHB and RDRAM. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#bplcon2)
- `BPLCON3` — Colour bank and LOCT for palette loads, PF2 colour offset, sprite resolution, border bits. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#bplcon3)
- `BPLCON4` — Bitplane colour-index XOR mask and the colour bases of even and odd sprites. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#bplcon4)
- `CLXCON2` — Adds bitplanes 7 and 8 to collision detection. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#clxcon2)
- `COLORxx` — 32 addresses reaching all 256 24-bit entries via BANK, one nibble set at a time (LOCT). → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#colorxx)
- `DIWHIGH` — High and 35ns bits for the display window, lifting the OCS start/stop restrictions. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#diwhigh)
- `DIWSTRT, DIWSTOP` — Display window corners; on AGA the low byte holds H9-H2 and any write clears DIWHIGH. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#diwstrt-diwstop)
- `FMODE` — Chip RAM fetch width for bitplanes and sprites, plus scan-doubling enables. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#fmode)
- `HBSTRT, HBSTOP` — Programmable horizontal blank start/stop; AGA adds a 35ns fine field in bits 10-8. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#hbstrt-hbstop)
- `LISAID` — Video chip ID: the low byte tells OCS Denise, ECS Denise and AGA Lisa apart. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#lisaid)
- `SPRxCTL` — Sprite end line, attach bit, and the extra vertical and 35ns horizontal position bits. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#sprxctl)
- `SPRxPOS` — Sprite vertical start low 8 bits and horizontal start bits SH10-SH3. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#sprxpos)
- `VPOSR` — Long-frame flag, Agnus/Alice chip ID, long-line flag and vertical beam bits 10-8. → [registers/aga.md](registers/aga.md#vposr)
